about: Recorded demo data for Module 7 (MGMT 615, fictional). Each module's 90-minute cohort session after the refresh: title, the decision it centers on, what students get live (feedback, own job, practice, instructor judgment, assessment preview), segments, the RSI moments, and setup needs for the Instructional Technologist. 'review' holds refresh flags and resolutions.

modules.title: Who Gets the Bonus?
modules.decision: Keep, adjust, or replace the pick-rate bonus
modules.live: Your judgment on a messy case
segments: 10 min: recap of Dana's situation, with a chat check-in: which piece of evidence worries you most?
30 min: each breakout gets one piece of evidence (bonus data, Luis's record, the crew's view)
35 min: groups combine evidence and recommend
15 min: instructor's call and why
review: 'Diagnosing Motivation Problems Roundtable' named no live moment and failed the recording test as written. Resolution: split-evidence breakouts added.

modules.title: Rehearse the Conversation With Jordan
modules.decision: Coach, warn, or coach and document
segments: 10 min: setup, with a poll: coach, warn, or coach and document?
50 min: breakouts of three, rotating Dana, Jordan, and observer
20 min: observers report the strongest line they heard
10 min: preview

modules.title: Fix the Handoff
modules.decision: Lunch, joint meeting, or a structural fix
modules.live: Applying the concept to their own job
segments: 10 min: poll on the 4:45 p.m. handoff: lunch, joint meeting, or a structural fix?
25 min: debate the split
40 min: groups design a handoff fix for a team they know
15 min: debrief
review: 'Team Diagnosis Roundtable' repeated the memo prompt. Resolution: students design a fix for a team they know.

modules.title: Telling Greg He's Wrong
segments: 10 min: the week’s Poll Everywhere results, and two students from each side say why
45 min: role-play in threes, Dana, Greg, observer
25 min: two volunteers replay for the class; instructor feedback
10 min: preview

modules.title: Twelve Things on the List
modules.live: A preview of the next assessment
segments: 10 min: setup, with a chat question: what's one task you should hand off?
40 min: groups sort Dana's list, then their own
30 min: groups defend one decision-rights call
10 min: preview
setup: Shared sorting board link in the chat

modules.title: Table Read: Ending the Bonus
segments: 10 min: setup, with a poll: what will the crew hear first?
50 min: students read drafts aloud in breakouts; peers play the crew
20 min: two drafts revised live with the class
10 min: preview

modules.title: Mock Interview Panel
segments: 10 min: setup, with a chat question: what's the one thing you'd ask every candidate?
50 min: panels of four interview a volunteer candidate with their scorecards
20 min: panels compare scores
10 min: course close
